note: Korean armor passive names and effect lines (in-game Korean text, as on Namu Wiki 'HELLDIVERS 2/방어구'). Keyed by the Helldivers Wiki passive page title. 'effects' follow the wiki description lines one for one; scripts/build-armor.mjs fails when a line count or any number differs from db/source/wiki_armor.json. 'name' must be a heading of db/source/namu_armor.json (for 'A, B' variants the part before the comma); null means no Korean name is known yet and the English name is shown. 'exact' (optional) lines up with 'effects': null, or [Korean, English] for the exact value the wiki page's Explanation gives where the game line is vague (e.g. 'higher armor rating' = +50); scripts/build-armor.mjs fails when its numbers differ between the two or are not on the wiki page. 'tips' (optional): facts from the Namu Wiki armor page (2026-11-19) the Helldivers Wiki lacks, shown apart as field tips (user request 2026-11-24). 'exactRounded' (optional): a number in 'exact' rounded from a wiki range, mapped to that range (Feet First 55 = the wiki's 54-56 m, user request 2026-11-24).

Extra Padding.name: 추가 완충제
effects: 더 높은 장갑 등급을 제공합니다.

Democracy Protects.name: 민주주의의 가호
effects: 치명적 대미지에도 50% 확률로 사망하지 않습니다.
흉부 출혈 시 출혈로 인한 모든 대미지를 방지합니다.

ko: 치명상을 버티면 체력 1이 남고 잠깐 무적이 되며, 다시 발동하려면 0.5초가 지나야 합니다.
en: A lethal hit you survive leaves you at 1 health with a moment of invulnerability, and it can trigger again after 0.5 seconds.

Servo-Assisted.name: 서보 보조
effects: 투척 거리가 30% 증가합니다.

ko: 투척물이 날아가는 속도가 30% 빨라지는 효과로, 스트라타젬을 평지에서 약 45m 대신 약 65m까지 던질 수 있습니다.
en: Throws fly 30% faster, so a stratagem beacon reaches about 65 m on flat ground instead of about 45 m.

Actually cuts recoil by 30% in every stance, on top of the usual crouch and prone reduction

Scout.name: 정찰
